newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sulzer Medica begins trading at 440 Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Sulzer Medica begins trading at 440 Sfr.

text.p: Sulzer Medica registered shares, which were sold by Sulzer AG in an initial public offering, opened at 440 Swiss francs on their first day of trading on the Swiss Exchange.
The initial trading price was well above the 350 franc per share issue price for the IPO announced by Sulzer late on Sunday.
Grey market prices were well above 350 francs before book building and even after the price range of 300 to 350 francs was set for the book building the price held above 400 francs.
Grey market prices on Friday were quoted at 425 to 465 francs per share.
Sulzer said on Sunday that the global IPO, which closed on July 11, was oversubcribed by more than 25 times.
Sulzer had made 2.3 million newly issued registered shares available for the offering.
Following the IPO approximately 24 percent of Sulzer Medica's share capital will be held by the public, with the rest remaining with the parent company.
Sulzer Medica makes orthopedic joints, heart pacemakers, artificial valves and arteries. It had sales of 1.6 billion francs in 1996 and employed 4,557 people. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
